caption: Castello di Lipari, Lipari
composition: Norman-Spanish citadel and cathedral on the rocky Aeolian acropolis · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The fortified citadel is seen from the water, its massive walls wrapping the rocky acropolis in the center of the frame. The cathedral with its bell tower rises above the walls at the top, and a small marina with moored sailboats tucks into the cove at the left. The sea surrounds the rock on both sides, with a hazy island on the right horizon. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 08:37 Europe/Rome: bright morning light under a partly cloudy sky.
